2. **Preserve the mathematical boundary.** The standard degree-16 classification gives: over characteristic other than 2, if A[2](k)=0 and a descended two-step (2,2) composite has a nonrational first kernel, its kernel must be A[2], so the map is [2] followed by a k-isomorphism. Good (4,4) kernels force a stable first kernel; mixed (4,2,2) kernels force a rational nonzero doubled point. The written geometry uses the cited double-Richelot classification; Lean covers explicit finite models, with the general abelian-variety/Picard bridge still open. A rational target equation does not establish descent of its selected morphism. Rational whole kernels with nonrational individual factors remain allowed. Review prior CT13/CT21/CT50 and primary literature before the next chain mechanism; do not infer arbitrary-length or trace/norm impossibility. [pcc:unverified]

Earlier #4544 default-latest counts do not establish all-attempt compliance; the additive erratum is in the current checkpoint. [pcc:unverified]
4. **Cost16 is published; do not repeat it.** #4990 contains the exact 128-blob historical result, source-A publication negative, inspected result/restart/CI PDFs and custody correction. Coarse vectors are 34 candidate-lower; inversion-input-expanded vectors are 2 lower/32 incomparable. The old 161,784-byte stdout and 66-member 1,773,712-byte archive are absent at the inspected owned tmpfs paths after restart; source/text/aggregates/guards/hashes survive. Do not invent custody or timings or relabel new work as old evidence. Prior #4544 merged 2026-11-17T15:16:40Z; no closed-branch pushes. Revert check due 2026-12-01T15:16:40Z. [pcc:unverified]
5. **Continue next unblocked research across repositories.** Finish #4992, then source-link the two-hop boundary to the cryptanalysis CT50 consumer after its ACTIVE-only tracking/draft step, or preregister a genuinely distinct longer-chain proof obligation after prior-art review. Keep cryptanalysis #1920, CT322/323/324 Prime31 controls and crypto #4964 CT326 work distinct. Computational-advantage claims require admitted matched complete-map/destination-solve/recovery accounting against the incumbent algorithms.
6. **Unchanged blocked obligations.** Original full LP60/240/62+360/witness/7controls/feedback/post and full 12,317-class workloads remain EKS-only. Paid STOPe42949 and unread locked crypto-autoresearcher VLT1-8edec422 remain binding. No budget/provider/identity/unlock workaround. Signed independent replay and the generic Rust Field/Picard bridge remain open. KB tools and Conductor are unavailable; the documented isolated source fallback makes no novelty/absence claim.
